title: 10 Days Sri Lanka Tour Package
highlights: Explore the best of Sri Lanka with Sri Lanka tour package for 10 days, where cultural treasures, stunning landscapes, and beaches create an unforgettable adventure.
Marvel at the UNESCO-listed Dambulla Cave Temple, where ancient rock art and Buddha statues offer a glimpse into Sri Lanka's spiritual and artistic heritage.
Get a chance to release baby turtles into the ocean at the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, a sanctuary dedicated to sea turtle conservation.
Witness the river bathing ritual of elephants at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where rescued elephants are cared for in a nurturing sanctuary.
Discover the art of tea-making at Kadugannawa Tea Factory, where you’ll witness the process and enjoy freshly brewed Ceylon tea amidst stunning plantation.
overview:
About the 10-Day Sri Lanka Tour Package:
This Sri Lanka Tour Package for 10-Days offers a perfect mix of culture, nature, and adventure. Begin your journey in Colombo, exploring vibrant cityscapes and historic landmarks. You'll also venture into the cultural heart of Dambulla and Sigiriya to witness ancient rock temples and the iconic Lion Rock Fortress. In Kandy, enjoy the serene beauty of the Royal Botanical Gardens and the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic. Discover the charm of Nuwara Eliya, fondly called 'Little England,' and relax amidst its lush tea plantations. Get a chance to spot the rich biodiversity of Yala National Park and relax on the golden beaches of Bentota. This 10-Days in Sri Lanka gives you a chance explore the island's timeless beauty and heritage.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Half-Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon your arrival at the Colombo Airport, get ready for your amazing 10 days in Sri Lanka​. From the airport, get driven to your hotel and check-in. After relaxing for a while, board your transfer to explore Colombo on a sightseeing tour. Visit St. Anthony's Church, a Catholic shrine, and marvel at its stunning neo-Gothic architecture. Then, visit the Beira Lake, nestled in the heart of Colombo, where you can opt for a scenic boat ride. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Dambulla | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to the Dambulla. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel & spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can head out & visit the Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage site, & soak in the amazing views. The majestic Lion’s Rock, a symbol of Sri Lankan heritage, offers a glimpse into the island’s royal history. Also, you can take a leisurely walk at Popham’s Arboretum Park, a lush botanical garden & home to indigenous plants. Later, return to your hotel on your own.

days.title: Dambulla Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, explore Dambulla on a sightseeing tour. Start with a visit to the Dambulla Cave Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Marvel at its stunning rock-cut caves adorned with intricate murals and over 150 Buddha statues. Next, get driven to the Buddhist Museum and witness exhibits showcasing Buddhist artifacts and relics, offering deeper insights into Sri Lanka’s rich spiritual heritage. Also, visit the Museum of Wall Paintings, where vibrant murals depict stories from Buddhist texts.

days.title: Visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Kandy | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Post check-out, visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, renowned for its dedication to rescuing and caring for orphan elephants. Get a chance to witness baby elephants bathed in the nearby river. Then, get driven to Kandy, the cultural capital of the island. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, enjoy a scenic drive around Kandy Lake, soaking in the beauty of the lush hills. In the evening, witness the Kandyan Dance Show, showcasing Sri Lankan traditional music and dance.

items.title: Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show

days.title: Full-Day Kandy Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, explore Kandy on a sightseeing tour and visit the Royal Botanical Gardens, home to over 4,000 plant species, including towering palms. Next, visit a local spice garden to uncover the secrets of Sri Lanka’s world-famous spices & learn about the Sri Lankan tea-making process from leaf to cup in the Kadugannawa Tea Factory. Also, marvel at the stunning Huluganga Falls and witness a relic of Buddha’s tooth at the sacred Tooth Relic, a UNESCO-listed site. Afterwards, get driven to your hotel.

items.title: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

days.title: Transfer to Nuwara Eliya | Visit to Lover's Leap Waterfall
days.desc: In the morning, check out & get driven to Little England, the Nuwara Eliya. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel & relax for a while. Later, board your transfer & get driven to visit the stunning Lover's Leap Waterfall, a hidden gem cascading from a height of 30 meters amidst lush tea plantations. As you walk along the stunning trail leading to the falls, enjoy the sound of gushing water & the cool mountain breeze. Also, capture amazing views of Nuwara Eliya before getting driven to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Yala | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, check-out and board your transfer for a scenic drive to Yala. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and spend the rest of your day at leisure. You can head out and board a safari Jeep to visit Yala National Park, Sri Lanka’s most famous & second-largest park. Feel the thrill of spotting a leopard and diverse wildlife in their natural habitat. Also, you can visit the Ruhunu Maha Kataragama Dewalaya, one of Sri Lanka’s most sacred pilgrimage sites, before returning to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer Bentota | Visit to Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to Bentota, a coastal town known for its golden beaches. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax for a while. Later, you'll be taken to the Kosgoda Turtle Hatchery, a conservation area for endangered sea turtles. Witness the incredible life cycle of these creatures, from hatchlings to adults being prepared for release. Also, learn about the center's efforts to protect marine life and get a chance to participate in releasing baby turtles to the ocean.

days.title: Full-Day Bentota Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, enjoy a sightseeing tour of Bentota and visit the stunning Bentota Beach, where golden sands meet turquoise waters, offering a perfect escape. Relax under the swaying palms or indulge in thrilling water sports like jet skiing and windsurfing. Later, set off on a scenic boat ride along the Madu River, surrounded by lush mangroves and exotic wildlife. Also, visit Cinnamon Island, where you can learn about traditional cinnamon cultivation and even try your hand at peeling cinnamon bark.

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check-out from your hotel in Bentota. Then board your transfer and get driven to Colombo Airport. Upon arrival, board your flight back home, marking the end to your amazing Sri Lanka tour package for 10 days.
